text: This report presents the external auditor (KPMG LLP)'s audit planning report for the City of Toronto (City)'s audited consolidated financial statements as of and for the year ended December 31, 2023.
The Audit Committee: 1. Received KPMG LLP's audit planning report for the City of Toronto's audited consolidated financial statements as of and for the year ended December 31, 2023 for information.
